The Assignor is indebted to the Lenders and the Holders pursuant to the terms of the Operative Agreements as that term and all other terms not otherwise defined herein are defined inAppendix A to that certainParticipation Agreement dated as of September,2000 among the Assignor, The Pep Boys - Manny, Moe & Jack, The Pep Boys Manny, Moe & Jack of California, The Pep Boys - Manny, Moe & Jack of Delaware, Inc., as the Lessees, the various parties thereto from time to time, as Guarantors, the various banks and other lending institutions which are parties thereto from time to time, as Holders and Lenders, and the Agent (as amended, modified, supplemented, restated and/or replaced from time to time, the “Participation Agreement").  B. The obligations of the Assignor to the Lenders and the Holders under the Operative Agreements are secured in part by (i) a Mortgage, Assignment of Leases, Security Agreement and Financing Statement dated as of September 22,2000,recorded in Reel 5705, Page 1982 in the Queens County, New York Registry; (i) a Mortgage, Assignment of Leases, Security Agreement and Financing Statement dated of September 22,2000,recorded in Reel 5705, Page 1998 in the Queens County, New York Registry; and (ii) a Mortgage, Assignment of Leases, Security Agreement and Financing Statement dated as of September 22, 2000, recorded in Reel 5705, Page 2014 in the Queens County, New York Registry all covering certain real located thereon(collectively, the“Mortgages"). C. All the obligations of the Assignor under the Operative Agreements have been assumed by the Assignee pursuant to an Assignment and Recharacterization Agreement dated as ofthedatehereof.  D.  The parties hereto desire to record this Agreement to reflect the assumption by the Assignee of the obligations of the Assignor under the Mortgages. NOW, THEREFORE, for and in consideration of the premises, the conveyance, the mutual covenants and agreements hereinafter contained, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto covenant, contract and agree as follows:  The Assignor hereby assigns, transfers and sets over unto the Assignee, and the Assignee hereby assumes, all the rights, obligations, duties, responsibilities and liabilities of the Assignor as set forth in the Mortgages.In connection therewith and without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the Assignee agrees to perform all the obligations provided in the Mortgages to be performed by the Assignor at the time, in the manner, and in all other respects as therein provided or as otherwise agreed in writing; and to be bound by all of the terms of the Mortgages all as fully and to the same extent as though such Mortgages, had originally been made, executed and delivered by the Assignee.  2. The Agent hereby consents to the assumption of the Mortgages by the Assignee and to the assignment of all leases on the Premises (as defined in the Mortgages) to which the Assignor is a party from the Assignor to the Assignee. 3. Except as herein modified, the Mortgages shall remain in full force and effect. 4. The whole of the Premises and improvements thereon as described in the Mortgages is and shall remain subject to the lien, charge, and encumbrances of the Mortgages which shall retain its priority as originally filed for record; nothing herein contained or done pursuant hereto shall affect or be construed to affect the lien, charge or encumbrances of the otherwise expressly provided, to release or affect the liability of any party or parties whomsoever would now or mayhereafter be liableunder or on account of anyof the OperativeAgreements. 5. The fees and expenses incurred by the Agent in connection with the assumption described herein, including attorneys fees and expenses, shall be paid by the Assignee. 6． This Agreement applies to, inures to the benefit of, and binds all parties hereto and their respective heirs, legal representatives, successors, and assigns. 7. This Agreement shall be construed in accordance with the laws of the State of NewYork. 8. ThisAgreement may be executed in several counterparts,all ofwhich shall constitutebut one and the same agreement. CHAR1714415_1 2
